rfc1576.title: TN3270 Current Practices
keywords: Telnet Option Terminal Type EOR Binary
rfc1576.abstract: This document describes the existing implementation of transferring 3270 display terminal data using currently available telnet capabilities.  The name traditionally associated with this implementation is TN3270.  This memo provides information for the Internet community.  This memo provides information for the Internet community.  This memo does not specify an Internet standard of any kind.

rfc1646.title: TN3270 Extensions for LUname and Printer Selection
rfc1646.abstract: This document describes protocol extensions to TN3270.  This memo provides information for the Internet community.  This memo does not specify an Internet standard of any kind.

rfc1647.title: TN3270 Enhancements
rfc1647.abstract: This document describes a protocol that more fully supports 3270 devices than do the existing tn3270 practices. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc2355.title: TN3270 Enhancements
rfc2355.abstract: This document describes a protocol that more fully supports 3270 devices than do traditional tn3270 practices. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc2561.title: Base Definitions of Managed Objects for TN3270E Using SMIv2
rfc2561.abstract: This memo defines a Management Information Base (MIB) for configuring and managing TN3270E servers.  The MIB defined by this memo provides generic support for both host and gateway TN3270E server implementations. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc2562.title: Definitions of Protocol and Managed Objects for TN3270E Response Time Collection Using SMIv2 (TN3270E-RT-MIB)
rfc2562.abstract: This memo defines the protocol and the Management Information Base (MIB) for performing response time data collection on TN3270 and TN3270E sessions by a TN3270E server. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc2877.title: 5250 Telnet Enhancements
rfc2877.abstract: This memo describes the interface to the IBM 5250 Telnet server that allows client Telnet to request a Telnet terminal or printer session using a specific device name.  This memo provides information for the Internet community.

rfc3049.title: TN3270E Service Location and Session Balancing
rfc3049.abstract: This document discusses the implementation of Service Location Protocol (SLP) and session balancing with a TN3270E emulator in a client server implementation with a TN3270E server. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc6270.title: The 'tn3270' URI Scheme
rfc6270.abstract: This document is the specification of the 'tn3270' Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) scheme, which is used to designate the access to the resources available via Telnet 3270 mode (TN3270) and Telnet 3270 Enhanced mode (TN3270E).  It updates RFC 1041 and RFC 2355, which specify these protocols, and RFC 1738, which firstly mentioned this URI scheme without defining its syntax and semantics. [STANDARDS-TRACK]
